e2ee_outcome_encrypted: This conversation will be end-to-end encrypted
e2ee_limitation_1: Messages, edits and attachments are end-to-end encrypted: the keys exist only on your devices and the other person's, never on the server.
e2ee_limitation_2: This protects you as long as the other person's key is really theirs. The first time you talk, the app trusts the key it is shown; you can compare safety numbers with them to be sure. If their key ever changes, you cannot send to them until you compare safety numbers again or choose to accept the risk. It does not protect you if either device is compromised.
e2ee_limitation_3: Reactions are not encrypted: the server can see which emoji you react with and to which message, and could change or add reactions.
e2ee_limitation_4: Replies in threads are encrypted, but the server can see which message they reply to, who replied and when.
e2ee_limitation_5: The server always sees who talks to whom, when, how often and how large the messages are.
e2ee_limitation_6: No search in this conversation; notifications say only who wrote, never what.
e2ee_limitation_7: Admins, moderators and the operator have no key and cannot read it. They can still stop messages from being delivered.
e2ee_limitation_8: Individual messages cannot be reported; you can report the person, block them, or send a screenshot (which cannot be verified).
e2ee_limitation_9: Only the desktop app can open it. A person added later, or a person who reset their encryption, cannot see earlier messages. Your own new device can, with your recovery phrase.
e2ee_limitation_10: If you lose your recovery phrase and all your devices, this history is gone for good. Deleting a message removes it from the server and hides it on other devices; it cannot erase copies they already hold.
e2ee_plain_title: This conversation will not be end-to-end encrypted
e2ee_plain_fallback_body: {{names}} cannot take part in an end-to-end encrypted conversation yet. If you continue, the server can read this conversation.
e2ee_plain_group_body: Group conversations are not end-to-end encrypted. The server can read this conversation.
e2ee_plain_inline: Not end-to-end encrypted: the server can read this conversation.
e2ee_blocked_operator_required: This server only allows end-to-end encrypted direct messages, and {{names}} cannot take part in one yet. They need the desktop app.
e2ee_blocked_operator_required_group: This server only allows end-to-end encrypted conversations, which are not available for groups yet.
e2ee_blocked_self_refuses: You only accept end-to-end encrypted direct messages, and {{names}} cannot take part in one yet.
e2ee_blocked_self_refuses_group: You only accept end-to-end encrypted conversations, which are not available for groups yet.
e2ee_blocked_participant_refuses: {{names}} only accepts end-to-end encrypted direct messages, and this one cannot be encrypted yet.
e2ee_blocked_participant_refuses_group: {{names}} only accepts end-to-end encrypted conversations, which are not available for groups yet.
e2ee_blocked_operator_disabled: Encrypted direct messages are turned off on this server, and {{names}} only accepts encrypted ones.
e2ee_blocked_generic: This conversation can't be created with these people.

e2ee_not_ready_restore: This conversation must be end-to-end encrypted. Set up or restore encryption on this device first.

e2ee_message_tampered: This message failed verification and is not shown.
